heroHeadline: China Launches Combined Naval-Air Drills Near Disputed South China Sea Shoal
heroSubtitle: China conducted combined naval and air force drills near a disputed South China Sea shoal, escalating tensions in the contested waterway. The exercise signals Beijing's continued assertiveness in pressing its sweeping territorial claims against rival claimants including the Philippines, Vietnam, and Malaysia. This follows a pattern of regional states strengthening defenses as South China Sea tensions reach new heights.
